name: 調理開始と分量・材料を備えたレシピの紹介
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE corrected Japanese Lighthouse recipe overview LH19-0001, portrait white canvas, compact polished complete UI.
Reference hierarchy: image 1 is the ORIGINAL Crouton screenshot and has highest authority for icon geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine controls. Image 2 is the actual original cookie PHOTO CROP; preserve its cookie arrangement, exact crop and colors, without regenerating a different photograph. Image 3 is our saved Japanese mock, SECONDARY authority for Japanese content only; its rough icons and omissions are not design authority. Image 4 is v001, the correction target; retain its white card and complete readable Japanese rows, fix controls below. Image 5 is approved Lighthouse STYLE only.
Restore ORIGINAL control details: white outlined play triangle in forest-green primary 「調理を始める」 button; shopping-basket and upload/share glyphs as quiet outlined slate supporting circular controls with Japanese labels 「買い物」「共有」; source people glyph beside 「12人分」 and clock glyph beside 「下準備 10分」, use original source proportions. Ingredient header has TWO distinct controls: 「分量を調整」 pill and separate sliders-settings icon button, as original. Do not copy missing/rough mock icons. Use one coherent outline weight, slate #526173, accurate aligned baselines.
Exact title 「チョコチップクッキー」, exact section 「材料」.
Exact nine ingredient rows, preserve source quantities and Japanese mock translations:
1 cup | 無塩バター（室温）
1 cup | グラニュー糖
1 cup | ブラウンシュガー
2個（大） | 卵
小さじ1 | バニラエッセンス
3 cup | オールパーパス粉
小さじ1 | 重曹
小さじ1/2 | 塩
2 cup | チョコチップ
Typography locked: Meiryo heading Bold 20/28, body Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0 at logical phone scale. Complete compact composition with no clipping. Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and card, fine neutral border, rounded corners, soft downward shadow. Primary gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E with white legible label. Original mint/amber/purple/blue utility accents are adapted to coherent slate because ordinary utilities have no state/group significance; forest green primary action remains emphasis. Preserve natural photograph colors. No invented content, unit conversions, navigation, decorative rainbow icons, heavy gloss or broad tints. Static design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原本優先へ修正。買物籠・共有・人数・時計・独立スライダー操作を復元し、日本語9材料行と値を実見確認。通常操作はスレート、主要操作は森林色。写真の配置／質感は再生成差が残り、原画像完全保持は未達。2回の限定試行を保存し、このIDは未受入のまま他項目へ続行。フォント厳密一致・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
